Outcome 4.1 - Drug abuse prevention and treatment
Output 4.1.1 - Evidence-based drug prevention tools and guidelines adapted, enhanced, and scaled-up

Output 4.1.4 - Capacities of the Governmental/ public sector and Civil Society Organizations for provision of services enhanced
Output 4.1.5 - Effectiveness of needs-based packages and programmes for prime target groups monitored and evaluated through operational and epidemiological assessments and reviews
